abstract_sentences.text: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold promise in embodied intelligence, their large parameter counts lead to substantial inference latency that hinders real-time manipulation, motivating parameter sparsification.

evidence.anchor: large parameter counts lead to substantial inference latency

abstract_sentences.text: However, as the environment evolves during VLA execution, the optimal sparsity patterns change accordingly.

evidence.anchor: as the environment evolves ... optimal sparsity patterns change

abstract_sentences.text: Static pruning lacks the adaptability required for environment dynamics, whereas fixed-interval dynamic layer pruning suffers from coarse granularity and high retraining overheads.

evidence.anchor: Static pruning lacks adaptability; fixed-interval pruning suffers

abstract_sentences.text: To bridge this gap, we propose EcoVLA, a training-free, plug-and-play adaptive pruning framework that supports orthogonal combination with existing VLA acceleration methods.

evidence.anchor: training-free, plug-and-play adaptive pruning framework

abstract_sentences.text: EcoVLA comprises two components: Environment-aware Adaptive Pruning (EAP) and Interleaved Inference Orchestration (I2O).

evidence.anchor: EcoVLA comprises two components

abstract_sentences.text: EAP is a lightweight adaptive channel pruning method that incorporates the temporal consistency of the physical environment to update sparsity patterns.

evidence.anchor: incorporates the temporal consistency of the physical environment

abstract_sentences.text: I2O leverages the FLOPs bubbles inherent in VLA inference to schedule the pruning method in parallel, ensuring negligible impact on latency.

evidence.anchor: leverages the FLOPs bubbles ... schedule ... in parallel

abstract_sentences.text: Evaluated on diverse VLA models and benchmarks, EcoVLA delivers state-of-the-art performance, achieving up to 1.60× speedup with only a 0.4% drop in success rate, and further reaches 2.18× speedup with only a 0.5% degradation when combined with token pruning.

evidence.anchor: up to 1.60× speedup ... 2.18× speedup ... combined with token pruning

abstract_sentences.text: We further validate the effectiveness of EcoVLA on real-world robots.

evidence.anchor: validate the effectiveness ... on real-world robots

reported_results: up to 1.60× speedup with 0.4% success-rate drop
2.18× speedup with 0.5% degradation with token pruning

introduction_moves.previous_question: Why are static parameter masks insufficient?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Static calibration masks fail when the task environment evolves and also incur retraining or reconstruction cost.

introduction_moves.previous_question: Why do fixed-interval dynamic methods remain inadequate?

introduction_moves.current_answer: Patterns evolve and instantaneous observations miss temporal continuity; online pruning itself adds latency in single-sample streaming.

narrative_analysis.strong_vs_weak: Strong claims cluster around state-of-the-art, commanding lead, fully taps, and redefines; weak qualifiers cluster around only, negligible, minor, and marginal. Exact counts are not inferred from automatic tokenization.

evidence.anchor: We attribute this phenomenon to the regularization effect

final_judgment.single_storyline: VLA sparsity changes with the physical scene; EAP uses visual similarity and temporal feature fusion to refresh structured channel/head masks, while I2O schedules the refresh in FLOPs bubbles so batch=1 control pays little added latency.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: The main text keeps the mask objective, EAP trigger/fusion/importance equations, I2O resource and latency model, hardware kernels, the pipeline figure, main tables, and speed/ratio/overhead/α-p analyses.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A-C move model and accelerator background, p/α settings, training and camera details, 20-placement protocol, workspace-boundary failures, and hyperparameter explanations. This keeps the body scannable but makes deployment reproducibility and scope dependent on appendix reading.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 aligns mechanism, data flow, shared memory, and time; Table 1 aligns vanilla, Wanda, EcoVLA, and stacked accelerators; Figure 4 turns the hidden-overhead claim into additive milliseconds.
final_judgment.largest_gap: The strongest adaptation and state-of-the-art claims lack direct pattern-detection or component-isolation evidence; aggregate point estimates omit uncertainty, and prose/table success-loss values are inconsistent.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For an online adaptive inference claim, put state transition, parallel scheduling, end-to-end latency, task-level success, component isolation, and failure boundary in one denominator-consistent evidence loop.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: This rule is supported for batch=1 embodied inference with continuous scenes and complementary GPU resource phases; it is untested for other batch sizes, hardware, sensor regimes, abrupt task changes, or unseen models.
